hooks.logic:
Set the next state to nothing.
Set the script register's 'execAbilityId' to nothing.
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
If part is ready to act, then
  If util passes a fraction roll of 30, then
    Set the script register's 'execAbilityId' to a weighted random move of part.
    Set the next state to 30.
  Otherwise, part picks and uses a weighted random move.

Let part be part 1 of the enemy.

yes.text: util passes a fraction roll of 30
Set the script register's 'execAbilityId' to a weighted random move of part.

no.text: Part picks and uses a weighted random move.
